PURPOSE The purpose of this procurement is to supply, deliver, commission, test, and place into service two (2) Mobile Elevating Work Platforms to support maintenance, inspection, installation, and repair activities within the Owner's facilities. The equipment shall be suitable for both indoor and outdoor maintenance operations and shall be capable of operating safely on finished architectural surfaces including marble, granite, terrazzo, polished stone, ceramic tile, porcelain tile, epoxy flooring, and similar floor finishes without causing damage or leaving any marks on the surfaces. The reference equipment for this procurement consists of: • Compact Crawler Boom Lift – Comparable to JLG X20JP • Electric Scissor Lift – Comparable to Genie GS-3232 These models are identified solely to establish the minimum acceptable level of performance. Equivalent equipment may be proposed provided it meets or exceeds all technical, operational, dimensional, and support requirements contained within this Scope of Work. 2. The school is located in a very small community with a population of less than 50,000. The Jeehdeez'a Elementary School was built in 2000, is made up of 5 main buildings, which include: Academics, Administration, Residential, Cafeteria, Gymnasium, and the Maintenance/Transportation Warehouse. There are also 17 staff quarters included on campus. Scope: The contractor will provide Propane Delivery service to the main 12,000-gallon tank, for operation of heating, broiler, and cooking equipment of the school on an annual basis. The contractor will also provide propane to vacant staff housing units to keep central units at minimal temperatures, avoiding damage to units throughout the seasons. deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/Attachment_1_-_Draft_Specifications.pdf ===== Requirements / Specification Document TITLE: Spatial Light Modulator Requesting Laboratory / Division / Group: Communications Technology Laboratory Radio Frequency Technology Division RFTD HQ Group (672.00) General Statement of Need: The requested spatial light modulator (SLM) system shall provide programmable wavefront and phase modulation of coherent optical beams to support advanced electro-optic sampling (EOS), ultrafast optical waveform metrology, and optical beam shaping applications. The system shall enable dynamic control of the spatial phase and amplitude of laser beams to generate arbitrary illumina

high phase stability, and computer-controlled operation with software interfaces compatible with automated laboratory control. The system shall support operation over the wavelength range used for EOS measurements, including near-infrared telecommunications wavelengths, while maintaining high optical efficiency and low wavefront distortion. The SLM is required to support development of SI-traceable electro-optic waveform measurements, spatially resolved electric-field characterization, adaptive optical alignment, and precision optical beam engineering for advanced photonic, semiconductor, and ultrafast metrology applications. A contractor providing IR services shall provide services that meet or exceed the American College of Radiology Guidelines https://www.acr.org/...IRClin-Prac-Mgmt. DESCRIPTION OF THE SUPPLIES OR SERVICES NEEDS (INCLUDING THE ESTIMATED VALUE) The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) is responsible for managing the public lands under its administration. Providing law enforcement and protective services in a consistent, efficient, and effective manner is a critical component to preserve public order and safety and to protect national interests in natural resources and infrastructure. The purpose of this contract is to obtain law enforcement services to assist BLM in the administration and regulation of the use and occupancy of the public lands.
